WITH interest_composition AS (
  SELECT 
    im.month_year,
    im.composition,
    im.interest_id,
    interest_name
  FROM bank_sales_trading.main.interest_metrics im
  JOIN bank_sales_trading.main.interest_map imap 
    ON CAST(im.interest_id AS INTEGER) = imap.id
  WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT 
  month_year,
  interest_name,
  composition
FROM interest_composition
WHERE (interest_name, month_year, composition) IN (
  SELECT interest_name, month_year, MAX(composition)
  FROM interest_composition
  GROUP BY interest_name, month_year
)
ORDER BY composition DESC
LIMIT 10
